Lip Sync Engineer

Experience: 57 Years
Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Chennai
Qualification: B.E / B.Tech / MCA

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Lip Sync Engineer to design, develop, and optimize AI-driven lip synchronization solutions for avatar-based video generation. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with open-source lip sync technologies and be capable of delivering near real-time lip synchronization aligned with generated audio.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and enhance lip synchronization systems for AI-generated avatars.
Implement solutions that synchronize avatar lip movements with audio within 1–3 seconds latency.
Work with and improve open-source frameworks such as Wav2Lip or similar models.
Integrate lip sync pipelines with Text-to-Speech (TTS) platforms such as ElevenLabs or equivalent.
Build and optimize avatar-based video generation workflows where static images are animated to speak.
Define and implement scalable compute infrastructure using AWS services such as EC2 and GPU instances.
Optimize models and pipelines for performance, latency, and output quality.
Collaborate directly with clients and cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
Troubleshoot and improve AI inference pipelines for real-time or near real-time processing.

Required Skills

Strong programming expertise in Python.
Hands-on experience with FastAPI and PyTorch.
Experience working with deep learning-based video and audio synthesis models.
Proven experience with lip sync technologies such as Wav2Lip or similar frameworks.
Experience integrating audio pipelines and TTS systems.
Familiarity with GPU acceleration and CUDA.
Strong understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Computer Vision concepts.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Hugging Face models and pipelines.
Knowledge of Piper or other Text-to-Speech engines.
Exposure to C++ for performance optimization.
Experience building real-time or near real-time ML inference pipelines.
Prior experience in avatar AI, talking-head generation, or AI video applications.
Experience working with AWS GPU infrastructure.



Mandatory Skills

Python, PyTorch, FastAPI, Wav2Lip, Deep Learning, Audio/Video Synthesis, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, CUDA, AWS GPU Infrastructure, TTS Integration.
